# Exact packed lookup-embedding row component V93/V94

Adds a component-only candidate: read only requested `model.embed_tokens` rows into a bounded FIFO of exact packed U32 weights and BF16 scale/bias bytes; use the existing MLX dequantization for values. Workers own private rows and retained descriptor handles, never MLX or shared cache mutation. All workers join before any batch insertion/eviction; failed batches leave valid prior rows and observations intact. At most4096positions per component call,32workers and8192cached rows are allowed. Runtime ResidentWeights, Model/MTP embedding calls and planner capacity remain unchanged.

The first V93 probe aborts before JSON: the scalar-ID oracle calls MLX dequantization on a rank-one vector, which the pinned primitive rejects. V94 preserves a one-row matrix for scalar lookups and restores requested shape after row math in both candidate/reference. An initial V94 attempt performs no model work because a separate context-check holds the lock; the later retry runs once after release and passes147assertions. Cases cover first/last vocabulary IDs, scalar/multidimensional/empty shapes, duplicates,1/16/17/18/255/256/1024/4096positions, reverse order, forced17-entry eviction, previous GPU output surviving eviction/drop, malformed IDs/shapes/overflow/oversized calls, and failures at five piece positions followed by exact recovery. All returned BF16 bits match independent direct gathers/dequantization from the original tensors. This is correctness-only evidence, not a cache latency, cold-disk or memory-saving qualification.

The actual three tensor headers confirm248320x320U32 weights plus two248320x40BF16 tensors:357,580,800bytes total. The8192row payload arithmetic is11,796,480bytes, before Swift/data/allocator/I/O overhead. The diagnostic retains full reference tensors intentionally; its endpoint footprint is not evidence that the runtime shed the table. Streaming integration would need checked main and MTP error propagation, public tensor-access compatibility, full-state/continuation and serving resource/performance gates before enabling it or crediting capacity.
